assessment_methods.method: Written test (design of algorithms and questions about course topics)

assessment_rules: The final exam evaluates knowledge, application of knowledge, independent judgment, communication skills, and ability to learn. It consists of an oral discussion of a project to solve a real problem and a written test involving algorithm design and questions on course topics. The final evaluation, expressed in thirtieths, depends on the maturity gained on the course content, the quality of the written test, and demonstrated judgment. A cum laude may be given for autonomous application of knowledge and correctly designed control algorithms with clear exposition. A mid-term test might account towards the final result.
